contracts.name: Exact Source Binding
contracts.law: S0 exact_text must occur verbatim in frozen E01 authority and carry line + slice hashes.

contracts.name: Current Role Authority
contracts.law: Roles absent from current frozen E01 cast return STALE_ROLE_BINDING.

contracts.name: Revision Freshness
contracts.law: Native revision drift requires re-export/re-hash before dispatch.

contracts.name: Authenticated Provider
contracts.law: No remembered/default model or output format; verified fresh snapshot only.

contracts.name: Inventory Candidate Set
contracts.law: Candidate sets require verified inventory hash, cap <=5, voice_lock=false.

contracts.name: Vivian Spoiler Neutrality
contracts.law: Metadata/direction cannot encode killer/villain guilt before evidence.

contracts.name: S0 Freeze
contracts.law: Source, provider capability, candidate-set hash and settings freeze before paid boundary.

contracts.name: Paid Boundary
contracts.law: Zero-paid plan cannot auto-dispatch; explicit authorization required.

contracts.name: Canary Provenance
contracts.law: Audio bytes require request hash + spend receipt + canonical metadata before admissibility.

contracts.name: Provider/Cast Evidence Ceiling
contracts.law: Provider evidence may create provisional eligibility only; never voice_lock or release GO.
